meta.title: Egypt agricultural reference context (governorate-level)
meta.scope: Egypt-focused MVP. Regional synthesis for orientation only; not a farm soil test, not a crop prescription, and not validated for every district.
meta.disclaimer: Dominant crops and soil/water descriptions are regional generalisations compiled from public country-level sources and general Egyptian extension knowledge. They must be verified with the governorate agricultural directorate and a laboratory soil test before decisions. No yield or profit claim is made.

nile_valley.label: Upper/Middle Nile Valley
nile_valley.soil_summary: Deep Nile alluvial soils, often clayey to silty, with high water-holding capacity. Calcareous patches, salinity and waterlogging can occur where drainage is poor.
nile_valley.water_context: Almost entirely irrigated from the Nile system; conjunctive groundwater use in some areas. Irrigation efficiency and drainage are major constraints.
nile_valley.rotation_note: Winter cereals and berseem clover commonly alternate with summer maize, sorghum, cotton or vegetables. Sugarcane is important in the southern governorates.

delta.label: Nile Delta and northern coast
delta.soil_summary: Alluvial Delta soils ranging from clay to loam, with sandy coastal fringes. High water tables, salinity and drainage problems are common in the north.
delta.water_context: Irrigated from the Nile Delta barrages and canals; rice cultivation is concentrated in the northern Delta. Drainage and salinity management are critical.
delta.rotation_note: Rice, cotton, maize, wheat, berseem and vegetables dominate, with sugar beet expanding in some areas.

canal.label: Suez Canal and Ismailia zone
canal.soil_summary: Sandy to sandy-loam desert fringe soils with low organic matter and limited water-holding capacity; localized salinity.
canal.water_context: Irrigated from canal systems and groundwater; water scarcity and salinity are significant constraints.
canal.rotation_note: Vegetables, cereals and fodder under irrigation; wind erosion and low organic matter are common concerns.

desert_oases.label: Western Desert oases and New Valley
desert_oases.soil_summary: Sandy and calcareous desert soils, often low in organic matter, with salinity risk under irrigation. Soil variability is high.
desert_oases.water_context: Dependent on groundwater and reclaimed desert irrigation; overdraft and salinization are key risks.
desert_oases.rotation_note: Wheat, maize, fodder, dates, olives and citrus in oases; wind erosion and low soil organic matter are common.

mediterranean.label: Mediterranean rainfed coast (Matrouh)
mediterranean.soil_summary: Shallow, stony calcareous soils with low organic matter. Rainfed agriculture is constrained by highly variable winter rainfall.
mediterranean.water_context: Mainly rainfed with supplementary water harvesting; drought risk is high.
mediterranean.rotation_note: Barley, olives, figs and limited legumes; cover and residue retention are important for erosion control.

sinai.label: Sinai
sinai.soil_summary: Sandy and stony desert soils with low organic matter; salinity and water scarcity vary sharply by location.
sinai.water_context: Local wells, springs and water harvesting; irrigation is limited and salinity risk is significant.
sinai.rotation_note: Barley, olives, dates and irrigated vegetables; protection from wind erosion is important.

red_sea.label: Red Sea coastal desert
red_sea.soil_summary: Arid, stony and sandy soils with very low organic matter; agriculture is restricted to local oases and wadis.
red_sea.water_context: Very limited groundwater and sporadic runoff; irrigation is highly localized.
red_sea.rotation_note: Limited dates, fodder and vegetables where water permits; regional crop rules are weakly validated.

Alexandria.soil_summary: Delta alluvial and coastal sandy soils; salinity and drainage problems near the coast.
Alexandria.water_context: Nile canal irrigation with coastal salinity risks.

Aswan.soil_summary: Nile alluvial and desert-fringe sandy soils; very hot, hyper-arid climate.
Aswan.water_context: Irrigated from the Nile and Lake Nasser system; high evaporative demand.

Asyut.soil_summary: Deep Nile alluvial soils, often clayey; drainage and salinity can vary locally.
Asyut.water_context: Nile irrigation; heat and waterlogging risks in poorly drained land.

Beheira.soil_summary: Delta alluvial soils with sandy and calcareous areas; salinity and water-table issues in the north.
Beheira.water_context: Nile canal irrigation and drainage networks; salinity management is important.

Beni Suef.soil_summary: Nile alluvial soils with clayey and calcareous patches.

Cairo.soil_summary: Urban fringe and Delta-edge alluvial soils; agriculture is highly fragmented.
Cairo.water_context: Canal irrigation and treated water use; urban pressure is dominant.

Dakahlia.soil_summary: Fertile Delta alluvial soils, mostly clayey to loamy; drainage varies.
Dakahlia.water_context: Nile canal irrigation; rice is water-intensive in this governorate.

Damietta.soil_summary: Northern Delta alluvial and coastal soils; high water table and salinity risk.
Damietta.water_context: Nile canal and drainage water; coastal salinity intrusion is a concern.

Faiyum.soil_summary: Alluvial and lacustrine soils in the Faiyum depression; salinity and drainage vary.
Faiyum.water_context: Irrigated from the Nile via the Bahr Yusuf canal; drainage to Lake Qarun.

Gharbiyya.soil_summary: Central Delta alluvial soils, generally fertile and clayey to loamy.
Gharbiyya.water_context: Nile canal irrigation; drainage and water-table management matter.

Giza.soil_summary: Nile alluvial and desert-fringe sandy soils; high urban pressure.
Giza.water_context: Nile canal irrigation and groundwater; reclaimed desert areas are common.

Ismailia.soil_summary: Sandy to loamy desert-fringe soils; low organic matter and salinity risk.
Ismailia.water_context: Canal and groundwater irrigation; water scarcity is a constraint.

Kafr el-Sheikh.soil_summary: Northern Delta clayey alluvial soils; high water table, salinity and drainage challenges.
Kafr el-Sheikh.water_context: Nile canal irrigation; rice dominates in wetter northern areas.

Luxor.soil_summary: Nile alluvial soils in a narrow cultivated strip; hot, dry climate.
Luxor.water_context: Nile irrigation with high evaporative demand.

Matrouh.soil_summary: Shallow calcareous and stony soils; low organic matter and high erosion risk.
Matrouh.water_context: Rainfed with water harvesting; highly variable rainfall.

Minya.soil_summary: Nile alluvial soils, often clayey; calcareous and sandy patches on the desert fringe.
Minya.water_context: Nile irrigation; heat and drainage are important constraints.

Monufia.soil_summary: Central Delta alluvial soils; generally fertile with localized drainage issues.

New Valley.soil_summary: Sandy and calcareous desert soils; low organic matter and salinity risk under irrigation.
New Valley.water_context: Groundwater-fed oasis agriculture; overdraft and salinization are key risks.
New Valley.confidence: regional synthesis; local variability is high

North Sinai.soil_summary: Sandy and stony desert soils; low organic matter and variable salinity.
North Sinai.water_context: Wells, springs and water harvesting; water scarcity is severe.
North Sinai.confidence: regional synthesis; local variability is high

Port Said.soil_summary: Coastal Delta soils with high water table and salinity risk; limited agricultural area.
Port Said.water_context: Canal irrigation with coastal salinity intrusion.

Qalyubia.soil_summary: Southern Delta alluvial soils; fertile but under strong urban pressure.

Qena.soil_summary: Nile alluvial soils in a narrow valley; hot and dry.
Qena.water_context: Nile irrigation; high evaporative demand and drainage constraints.

Red Sea.soil_summary: Arid stony and sandy soils; very low organic matter.
Red Sea.water_context: Very limited groundwater and runoff; agriculture is highly localized.

Al Sharqia.soil_summary: Eastern Delta alluvial soils with sandy desert-fringe areas; salinity varies.
Al Sharqia.water_context: Nile canal irrigation; reclaimed desert areas depend on groundwater and canal extensions.

Sohag.soil_summary: Deep Nile alluvial soils, often clayey to silty, with calcareous patches and localized salinity where drainage is poor.
Sohag.water_context: Irrigated from the Nile; high evaporative demand and drainage management are important.
Sohag.pilot_note: Sohag is the pilot region. The application's crop and scoring assumptions are most exercised here.

South Sinai.soil_summary: Mountainous and stony desert soils; very low organic matter, localized salinity.
South Sinai.water_context: Springs, wells and water harvesting; extremely limited water.

Suez.soil_summary: Sandy desert-fringe soils; low organic matter and salinity risk.
Suez.water_context: Canal and groundwater irrigation; limited water availability.
